titulo: The frame, finally on the wall
caption:
The frame, finally on the wall

The frame had leaned against the floor since the move. Up on the wall, it was a picture again.

A frame on the floor is a thing waiting to be kicked, and a frame on the wall is the reason you bought it.

For whoever hangs the frame that has been leaning on the floor since the move.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A bedroom with a black frame holding an orange drop leaning against the floor at the middle. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes trembles at the left, then its eyes go wide, it steps closer and the frame floats up in an arc and settles high on the right, straight. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text changes from: me: it's fine on the floor, to: hung it. now it's a picture.
